snippet.title: Candy Shop Simulator - Release Trailer | STEAM
snippet.description:
Open the doors to sugary success! 🍭 Candy Shop Simulator is now available on Steam! 👇 🍬
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811530/Candy_Shop_Simulator

Step into a world of sweetness with Candy Shop Simulator! 😊 Create delicious pastries, manage your shop, and build a thriving candy empire. 🍪 Available now on Steam - start your confectionery adventure today! 🩷
